# HexPiece 3.8.5

The first of the weapon reworks: a swordsman's blade forces third person. **Not tested in game yet:** the build and all test suites
pass.

## Blades in third person, the camera over the shoulder
"Swords in first person are being weilded in a very strange way and unrealistic, I dont Like any of it, from now on, when grabbing a
blade as a swords man you'll go into third person, forcefully, the camera adjusts to better aid your swings and aim."
- **Drawing your blade switches the view to third person**, and it stays there while the blade is out (pressing F5 cannot take it
  back to first person). Sheathe it and the view goes back to first person if that is where you were.
- **The camera moves over your right shoulder** (a little closer than the normal third-person view, a little higher, off to the
  right), gliding there as you draw and back as you sheathe, so your blade's swings and what your crosshair is on are both in view
  instead of the back of your head covering the target. It never goes into a wall behind you.
- The other weapon reworks (the Katana, Saber, Mace, Yoru and Gun categories, the mace and the gun, the clothes) come next.
